labels.label: btzprop:pgcd
labels.notes: Row correctly stays partial and unmarked: E0 only (T-btz-scope), disclosed in Pgcd.lean's checklist. No mark (**`label`**) added or removed in Pgcd.lean, PpcmHausdorff.lean, or the new ExtChart.lean, which carries none. Statements compared at the elaborated-type level: old Pgcd.lean (HEAD = /tmp/Pgcd.orig.lean) concatenated with old PpcmHausdorff.lean, then elaborated, against the new ExtChart+Pgcd+PpcmHausdorff environment. The same 60 non-internal declarations, with the same full names and identical `Expr` types once hygienic instance-binder names are normalised. That covers the 16 moved declarations, GX.Pgcd.globallyHyperbolicOn_dom and GX.Pgcd.btz_pgcd_gh. The binder rename hG0 -> _hG0 is a non-dependent arrow, so the type is unchanged. The section GH' variable block is textually the old section GH block, and the GraphCluster def body is verbatim. globallyHyperbolicOn_dom is now the term PpcmHausdorff.globallyHyperbolicOn_maxDom hi hj hG1 hG2 and no longer has a sorry. The REPORT's two findings were checked against BTZ_1.tex l.1341-1378 and are correct. (a) l.1351 takes the union over globally hyperbolic domains only, so 'by construction maximal' (l.1376) needs dom i j to be globally hyperbolic, and that is the content of the ppcm third bullet. (b) btz_pgcd_gh_of_gh has no M0-globally-hyperbolic hypothesis and no M2 connected / second-countable hypotheses. Hypotheses carried but unused (M0 globally hyperbolic, M2 connected and second countable) and the added hypothesis (M1 connected) are all disclosed in the checklist.

build.detail: `lake env lean` on ExtChart.lean, Pgcd.lean and PpcmHausdorff.lean gives no errors and no warnings. Each file has 0 `sorry` tokens outside docstrings; the grep hits are prose only. #print axioms gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for GX.Pgcd.globallyHyperbolicOn_dom, GX.Pgcd.btz_pgcd_gh, GX.Pgcd.btz_pgcd, GX.PpcmHausdorff.t2Space_ghGlue, GX.PpcmHausdorff.exists_ext_of_graphCluster, GX.PpcmHausdorff.globallyHyperbolicOn_maxDom and GX.PpcmHausdorff.btz_pgcd_gh_of_gh. The probes were written under the campaign directory and deleted. The concurrent target's BTZ/Ppcm.lean, which imports PpcmHausdorff, still elaborates against the new modules; it raised only an unused-section-variable linter warning, which is that target's own file. `lake build` was not rerun, as the dispatch restricted the check to `lake env lean`.
